feature: Marketplace: wire the customer-facing /marketplace page to the real GET /api/portal/marketplace/catalog endpoint (servicesTable), replacing the fully fabricated INITIAL_PRODUCTS placeholder data. Read-only styling pass per Shane's own scoping -- add-to-cart/checkout intentionally deferred to a later build.
notes: GATE MECHANISM: none new -- reuses the existing requireRole('Assessment') floor on GET /api/portal/marketplace/catalog (portal-marketplace.ts), which was already built and already RBAC-scoped but had zero frontend consumers before this build. MarketplaceModal.tsx now fetches it via useMarketplaceCatalog.ts (React Query) instead of importing the deleted products.ts mock file.

Category pills are now derived live from whatever `category` values the fetched catalog actually contains -- no hardcoded taxonomy -- so D2 below only asserts against the real first product's name, not a specific category label that could drift.

Cart/checkout intentionally NOT covered here: SubscriptionsDrawer.tsx is a real-data selection review panel only ('Cart & checkout coming soon'), per Shane's explicit scoping for this pass. No apiTest hits a purchase/checkout endpoint.
ENV VARS required in BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL, TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD (same TESTBED account other portal manifests use).
